authority: proposed by the 2026-09-16 model-design task; not an approved replacement for existing Table 1 protocols
seed_meaning: trainable downstream module initialization, batch order, dropout and pair sampling; frozen encoder/cache is identical

icbhi_flat4.split: official train/test; patient-grouped internal validation inside official train

spr_binary.split: official train with patient-grouped internal validation; inter primary test

hf_cas.unit: 15-s recording represented by mean-pooled frozen embeddings from three 5-s windows
hf_cas.eligibility: recording contains at least one D/Wheeze/Rhonchi/Stridor annotation
hf_cas.positive: at least one Wheeze, Rhonchi or Stridor annotation
hf_cas.negative: D-only within the eligible annotated pool
hf_cas.excluded: phase-only, gap-only and empty annotation records
hf_cas.terminal: source-test CAS AUROC once after selection
hf_cas.metric: HF CAS AUROC from a dedicated CAS head, not p_W proxy

kauh_binary.unit: patient after mean aggregation of B/D/E frozen recording embeddings
kauh_binary.split: fixed five-fold patient OOF with internal validation in each development fold

reporting.aggregate: mean and sample standard deviation over downstream seeds 0/1/42
